messages.subject: Lyra – liability cap strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Pennland want 200% of 12-months' Charges and uncapped DP liability. Nadia has authorised up to 125%. I propose we land at 125% of trailing 12-months' Charges, accept the 99.7% availability, but pull the credit cap back to 10% while restoring a softened 'sole remedy' for the availability SLA, and offer a £1,000,000 super-cap for data-protection breaches rather than uncapped. Uplift cap I'd settle at 4%.

Agree?

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
